title: Picture list: Refresh List and Generate against what is already in the .piclist
events: An edit in the list that isn't saved yet, then Refresh List. None of these pictures is in the text, so nothing may change or go
Generate, adding the pictures in JON's text and protecting what is in the list
Change one of the pictures from the text: caption, size, and move it to another verse
Refresh List takes the caption back from the text, but keeps the size and where it was moved to
Generate again, protected: the moved picture is still the same picture, so it isn't added again
Awkward: open Generate and cancel it
